Frontend: /console/fidelite 'Code de parrainage' section shows all four data-testids (loyalty-code-prefix / -length / loyalty-validity / loyalty-code-preview) with defaults DINA / 4 / 90; preview updates live when fields change (verified: typing 'TEST' into prefix + length=6 → preview 'DINATEST-XXXXXX'). /boutique: OpeningHoursBanner mounts without errors (hidden when opening_hours empty — expected); after seeding opening_hours with all 7 days closed:true via PATCH /api/site, [data-testid=hours-banner] appears with text 'Boutique fermée actuellement · vos commandes seront traitées quand nous rouvrirons', the X button dismisses it AND sets sessionStorage.dina_hours_dismissed='1'. Regression smoke: all 15 /console/* pages (dashboard, produits, commandes, avis, approbations, audit, preparation, livraisons, sessions-caisse, pos, pointage, fidelite, manuel, zones, livreurs) load with zero pageerrors / zero TypeError. Rider login form only renders 1 input (likely a PIN/code flow or multi-step) — did not fully exercise rider-topbar propagation but navigation didn't crash; main agent to confirm.

minor.issue: No backward-compat merge of DEFAULT_LOYALTY — if the loyalty_settings doc was persisted BEFORE the new fields (referral_code_prefix / referral_code_length / referral_validity_days) were introduced, the GET response omits them entirely. Our first pytest run failed on this (legacy doc without new fields); it only passed after a PATCH forced persistence. Fix: in loyalty_settings() handler at server.py:3296, merge `{**DEFAULT_LOYALTY, **s}` (or at least these 3 fields) before `return clean(s)` so the frontend never crashes on `s.referral_code_prefix` being undefined for pre-upgrade installs.

issues: React hydration warning: `<span>` cannot be a child of `<option>` — caused by the visual-editor instrumentation wrapping option labels in a `<span data-ve-dynamic>`. Non-blocking (functional) but pollutes the console and may break SSR if ever enabled. Pre-existing, not an iter29 regression.

action_items: server.py:3296 — merge DEFAULT_LOYALTY defaults into the response of GET /api/loyalty/settings so legacy stored docs expose the 3 new referral_code_* fields without needing a first PATCH.
(Optional) Investigate the `<span> inside <option>` hydration warning from the visual-editor runtime — strip the data-ve wrapper for `<option>` children, or move it to the `<select>` wrapper.
critical_code_review_comments: GET /loyalty/settings returns the raw mongo doc without merging DEFAULT_LOYALTY — any new field added to LoyaltySettingsIn becomes invisible on existing deployments until an admin saves the form. Same anti-pattern likely in other */settings endpoints (site, delivery_templates…) — audit for `find_one(...) or <default>` style and ensure the found-case also merges defaults.

LoyaltySettingsIn has no validators on referral_code_prefix (allows empty string, whitespace, lowercase, special chars). Frontend uppercases + slices to 8, but backend accepts anything — add `constr(min_length=1, max_length=8, pattern=r'^[A-Z0-9]+$')` and `conint(ge=3, le=8)` for length.

routers/meta.py is wired correctly (prefix='/api', tags=['meta']) and server.py appends include_router(meta_router) — scaffold is clean. However the existing @api.get('/') in server.py (if any) and the new meta.py do NOT share routes yet — document that /api/health is the ONLY route served by meta.py so future contributors don't accidentally duplicate.

OpeningHoursBanner computes isClosed on mount only (no useInterval) — if a user leaves /boutique open past opening/closing time, the banner won't appear/disappear. Minor UX, but worth a 60s setInterval re-check.

OpeningHoursBanner falls back to `rouvrirons` when it can't find a next-open day — this happens when ALL 7 days are `{closed:true}` (our seeded test case). That's a nonsensical config in production but the banner text ends up ungrammatical ('nous rouvrirons' with no time). Consider hiding the banner entirely if no next-open can be computed, or showing 'Horaires non définis'.

rca of the issue: Minor backend regression risk: GET /api/loyalty/settings returns the DB doc verbatim. The LoyaltySettingsIn pydantic model gained 3 new fields (referral_code_prefix/length/validity_days) with defaults, but those defaults are NOT applied on reads — only on writes (via model_dump() in PATCH). On any environment that was running pre-iter29, the stored loyalty_settings/{id:main} doc lacks the 3 fields, so the frontend sees undefined and renders fallbacks (|| 'DINA', || 4, || 90) — which is why the UI looked correct. Reproduction: delete the 3 fields from the mongo doc, GET /api/loyalty/settings → fields absent. Mitigation: at server.py:3296, replace `return clean(s)` with `return clean({**DEFAULT_LOYALTY, **s})` so defaults are always exposed.
